climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune village in Burgundy making red wine only, mainly from Pinot Noir. It has no Grand Cru vineyards but several highly regarded Premier Crus, and the AOC dates from 1937.
